name: Subscription Gifts for WooCommerce
author: wpgenie2

sections.description:
Subscription Gifts for WooCommerce is WooCommerce Subscriptions addon that automatically adds free gift products to your customer’s subscription.

Reward your loyal subscribers by effortlessly adding free gifts to their WooCommerce Subscriptions. Can be used with any type of WooCommerce product.

A must-have for competition-based subscriptions. If you’re running subscriptions with our Lottery plugin and Pick Number addon, this add-on lets you easily gift free competition tickets to subscribers.

Features

  • Add gift on subscription start
  • Add any type of product as a gift
  • Easy to set up and use

PRO Features

All features of the free version, plus:

  • Add gift on subscription start, renewal or both
  • Set the quantity of each gifted product
  • Premium support: Direct access to our ticket support system at https://wpgenie.org/support/

Use Cases

  • Add free gift and reward your customers for subscribing
  • Add free gift to renewal order to show long-term subscribers you appreciate their
    loyalty
  • Gift free tickets to subscription-based competitions
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or greater

Setup

This section describes how to install Subscription Gifts for WooCommerce plugin and get it working.

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.

If you have any problems contact us at http://wpgenie.org/
